The '''Diadem of the Daughter-Heir''' is the ceremonial crown awarded to the [[Daughter-Heir]] of [[Andor]]. It is a simplified version of the [[Rose Crown of Andor]], a single highly wrought golden rose on a slim gold band. It first appeared when worn by [[Elayne Trakand]] in [[Winter's Heart]].
